job.title: Lead Interface & Interoperability Analyst
job.description:
Duration: 12 months to start

Job Description
Our client is modernizing its healthcare interoperability program to meet new federal data-exchange mandates, and is looking for a Lead Interface & Interoperability Analyst to take technical ownership of that work. You'll manage and optimize a complex portfolio of HL7 and FHIR-based interfaces built on Infor Cloverleaf and MarkLogic, lead compliance work for CMS's Patient Access, Provider Directory, Provider Access, Payer-to-Payer, and Prior Authorization APIs, and help plan a migration of the Cloverleaf integration engine to new infrastructure. You'll also lead a small team of interoperability contractors and act as the primary technical liaison to IT leadership — senior, highly visible technical leadership on live federal compliance work, not routine interface maintenance.

Responsibilities

  • Manage, monitor, and maintain HL7 and FHIR-based healthcare interfaces, ensuring availability, accuracy, and reliable data exchange
  • Oversee the Infor Cloverleaf integration engine, including interface configuration, message routing, transformation, error handling, and performance tuning
  • Triage and resolve interface failures, message errors, and data exchange issues, coordinating with external trading partners (MCOs, providers, payers, and agencies) as needed
  • Support compliance with CMS-9115-F and CMS-0057-F interoperability rules, including FHIR API implementation, testing, validation, and go-live support across Patient Access, Provider Directory, Provider Access, Payer-to-Payer, and Prior Authorization APIs
  • Conduct a current-state assessment of existing interfaces and lead a structured process-improvement effort to close gaps and improve reliability and performance
  • Develop and maintain interface specifications, data flow diagrams, mapping documents, SOPs, and runbooks
  • Implement and govern document management practices (version control, access, retention) for interoperability and compliance documentation
  • Plan and execute the Cloverleaf configuration migration to new infrastructure, including validation testing and post-migration verification
  • Lead and direct a small team of interoperability contractors — assigning work, reviewing deliverables, and providing technical direction
  • Serve as the primary technical liaison between the interoperability function and IT leadership, including status reporting and participation in compliance reviews

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive healthcare IT experience with hands-on HL7 and/or FHIR-based interface work
  • Hands-on experience with a healthcare integration engine (Infor Cloverleaf, Rhapsody, MuleSoft, InterSystems, or similar)
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare data standards: HL7 v2.x, HL7 FHIR R4, CDA, CCDA, X12, and USCDI data elements
  • Experience with healthcare interoperability in a Medicaid, managed care, hospital/health system, or EHR environment, including EHR interfaces and clinical data exchange
  • Experience implementing and governing document management systems
  • Experience leading or supervising technical teams or contractors, including work assignment and quality review
  • Strong understanding of HIPAA Privacy and Security Rule requirements as they apply to healthcare data exchange
  • Experience with interface documentation and data flow mapping
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting findings to IT leadership
  • Master's degree in Information Technology, Health Informatics, or a related field
  • Must be able to pass a background investigation prior to starting
  • Willingness to complete required security awareness training and sign a confidentiality agreement (NDA)

Preferred

  • Experience in state or federal government IT, ideally within a Medicaid, healthcare, or human services agency
  • Direct experience supporting CMS-9115-F and CMS-0057-F mandates, including FHIR API implementation and compliance documentation
  • Experience with Infor Cloverleaf configuration, administration, and environment migration
  • Experience with MarkLogic or a similar NoSQL database in a healthcare data context
  • Experience with FHIR API development or testing, including US Core and Da Vinci Implementation Guides
  • Experience with SMART on FHIR and OAuth 2.0 authentication frameworks
  • HL7 certification or equivalent industry credential
  • Experience with AWS in a healthcare or government context
  • PMP or similar project management certification
  • Experience with CMS ARC-AMPE security requirements

Job Description
  • The IT Strategic Sourcing & Purchasing Consultant will provide procurement support across the organization, with primary responsibility for IT-related sourcing, supplier management, contract negotiations, and renewal optimization.
  • In addition to supporting technology procurement activities, this role will assist with sourcing and purchasing initiatives across other spend categories as business needs require.
  • This consultant will partner closely with IT, Purchasing, Finance, Legal, and business stakeholders to drive value through strategic sourcing, effective supplier management, and efficient procurement operations.
  • The role will also be responsible for performing day-to-day purchasing functions, including requisition processing, purchase order management, contract amendments, and procurement administration.
  • The ideal candidate is a hands-on procurement professional with strong negotiation skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to build productive stakeholder relationships while achieving cost savings and process improvements.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Sourcing
  • Serve as a procurement partner for IT-related spend categories, including software, SaaS, hardware, cloud services, telecommunications, and professional services.
  • Support sourcing activities across additional indirect and direct spend categories as needed.
  • Lead and support RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, supplier evaluations, and competitive bidding events.
  • Negotiate pricing, contract terms, statements of work, and renewals to achieve optimal commercial outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to consolidate suppliers, contracts, and renewals across the organization to leverage purchasing volume and improve pricing.
  • Conduct spend analysis, market research, and supplier benchmarking to support sourcing decisions.
  • Partner with stakeholders to develop sourcing strategies that balance cost, quality, service, and business requirements.
  • Support supplier performance management and relationship development.
Purchasing Operations
  • Create, review, and process purchase requisitions and purchase orders in accordance with company policies and procedures.
  • Manage purchase order revisions, change orders, amendments, and closeout activities.
  • Facilitate contract renewals and amendments while ensuring compliance with procurement requirements.
  • Maintain accurate procurement records, pricing information, contracts, and supplier documentation.
  • Coordinate with Accounts Payable, Legal, Finance, and suppliers to resolve purchasing, invoicing, and contract-related issues.
  • Monitor open purchase orders and ensure timely follow-up and completion.
  • Support procurement reporting, spend analysis, savings tracking, and supplier metrics.
Required Skills & Qualifications
  • 5+ years of procurement, purchasing, and strategic sourcing experience, with a strong preference for technology-related products and services, including software, SaaS, hardware, cloud services, and professional services.
  • Demonstrated negotiation and supplier management expertise, with a proven ability to secure favorable pricing, contract terms, and measurable cost savings.
  • Experience reviewing, negotiating, and managing contracts, renewals, amendments, and supplier agreements, while identifying opportunities for spend consolidation, supplier rationalization, and procurement optimization.
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with the ability to effectively partner with IT and business stakeholders while balancing operational needs, risk, and cost objectives.
  • Highly analytical, detail-oriented, and organized, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, sourcing initiatives, and procurement transactions simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with ERP and procurement systems, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Office applications, including experience supporting purchasing operations such as requisitions, purchase orders, and spend analysis.

  • Knowledge of software licensing models, SaaS agreements, cloud services, and IT supplier ecosystems.
